```yaml
name: Blob Size Policy
on:
  push:
    branches: [ main ]
  pull_request:
    branches: [ main ]

jobs:
  pin-zig-action:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Check for pinned zig action
        run: |
          # Check if the workflow files contain the pinned zig action
          if grep -q "mlugg/setup-zig@d1434d08867e3ee9daa34448df10607b98908d29" .github/workflows/rust-ci.yml; then
            echo "rust-ci.yml already has pinned zig action"
          else
            echo "rust-ci.yml needs pinned zig action"
            exit 1
          fi
          
          if grep -q "mlugg/setup-zig@d1434d08867e3ee9daa34448df10607b98908d29" .github/workflows/rust-release.yml; then
            echo "rust-release.yml already has pinned zig action"
          else
            echo "rust-release.yml needs pinned zig action"
            exit 1
          fi
          
          if grep -q "mlugg/setup-zig@d1434d08867e3ee9daa34448df10607b98908d29" .github/workflows/shell-tool-mcp.yml; then
            echo "shell-tool-mcp.yml already has pinned zig action"
          else
            echo "shell-tool-mcp.yml needs pinned zig action"
            exit 1
          fi
```
